name: ccbar
description: ccbar — a quiet status band above the prompt, drawn natively by Claude Code's function hooks: the model and its effort, the repository (GitHub owner/name, branch, staged+unstaged diff), a context bar coloured by the /context categories with used/total and load, the session's new tokens (cache reads of the re-sent conversation left out) counted once per API response, and the session and weekly rate limits with their reset countdowns. Colour carries meaning (identity, mode, load), and refreshes are paced: a 60 s idle tick plus every turn end. Function hooks only: no command hooks, no MCP, no settings patching.
